facts.fact: Tunisia's National Frequency Agency hosted the Third African Preparatory Meeting for WRC-27 (APM27-3) in Tunis, coordinated by the African Telecommunications Union, with African governments and regulators attending; the document is dated 2026-09-17 and says the four-day meeting began that September.

Ms Sana Souai Lakhal of Tunisia's National Frequency Agency took over as Chairperson of the African preparatory process for WRC-27 from Kenya's Mohamed A. Haji, at the Tunis meeting reported on 2026-09-17.
